kind: Design hypothesis and model observations, not a publication receipt
hypothesis: An existing optional receiver repair that changes a shared pursuit and retreat connection lets knowledge of the clinic, market and freight hall support deliberate survival choices.
change: Split the old west wall around a powered loading shutter and give its landing a raised sorting screen. Reuse the original task, battery dependency, reward and all existing chapter progression.

primary_observation.scope: Isolated model fixture using actual update, acceleration and swept body collision; no enemies and no sprint; not native or human timing

normal_start_model_comparison.scope: Reproducible model-action preflight, not browser or physical-input evidence. Both collect actual supplies, craft, heal through ordinary actions, repair the receiver, recover both objects and return to the clinic before the routes diverge. No inventory, enemy or player-position grants.
normal_start_model_comparison.inference: In these model runs the longer route traded speed for lower damage; this does not establish human preference, fixed difficulty or an optimal policy.

revealing_checks: An early exposed-return model experiment died; subsequent paired traces distinguish a viable but costly central return from the longer western recovery. These are design diagnostics, not native acceptance.

A code review found that a ground-solid new screen could bury an older saved loot drop. Raising its bottom to 0.6 preserves ground-level collection and prone clearance while retaining the standing sightline break. A constructed legacy fixture verifies unchanged quantities and no replayed reward.
The rolled shutter now sits within the existing lintel's blocked volume, not below the collision-free opening.
The first transport version logged a nonexistent top-level snapshot time; this was corrected to stats.seconds before native execution, without changing game code.

guardrails.opening_cost: Shared sight, projectile and NPC access, not a player-only safe route
guardrails.legacy_state: Existing completed ward-radio determines the opening; there is no migration or new checkpoint field
guardrails.source_boundary: Only Rainward, its required acceptance workflow and one Rainward paragraph in the shared library change

acceptance_state.native_candidate: Run 35061082747 tests the preceding integrated candidate; inspect its actual reports before crediting success
acceptance_state.final_native: Required on the final PR source

next_question: Can an unfamiliar player explain the receiver-to-shutter consequence and choose the recovery passage for a reason, then use that knowledge differently on return?
